build_histgradientboosting_regressor: build a histogram-based gradient boosting regressor model for big datasets with native NaN support
build_histgradientboosting_classifier: build a histogram-based gradient boosting classifier model for binary and multiclass classification
fit_ensemble_model: fit a HistGradientBoosting regressor or classifier model on training data with optional sample weights
predict_ensemble_model: predict values or classes from a fitted HistGradientBoosting model on new input data
early_stop_ensemble_training: enable early stopping during HistGradientBoosting training with validation data and configurable scoring
